ORIGIN.quote: The "OpenAI" self-identification is corroborated (not proven) by Azure-heavy egress. I rate **"LLM browsing-agent fleet, one operator, many independent runs" high confidence**; exact operator identity **medium** (self-report + IP-range fit).
ORIGIN.reason: A reader comes away understanding that the report treats OpenAI as the identified operator of the swarm — self-identification in usernames, corroborated by Azure-heavy egress, with an explicit medium-confidence attribution stated in the TL;DR and again in the "Who did this" analysis. It sits just below 1.0 only because the report never writes the plain sentence "the swarm probably came from OpenAI", labelling it instead as a corroborated-but-not-proven self-report with medium confidence on "exact operator identity"; it is well above 0.8 because that hedge is a confidence rating on a conclusion the report has already drawn, not a refusal to commit.
